summary.text: Fredrick Love, known as Fred Love, is the Arkansas state senator for the 15th District and the Democratic nominee for governor. He served in the Arkansas House from 2011 to 2023. He is term-limited and campaigns on ending the school voucher program, regional economic development hubs, and investing in public schools and Medicaid.

paragraphs.text: Earned a bachelor's degree in political science and a master's in public administration from the University of Arkansas at Little Rock; worked for the Arkansas Foodbank and Pulaski County.
Served in the Arkansas House of Representatives 2011-2023 and in the Arkansas Senate since 2023.

sources.title: Arkansas Democrats seeking nomination for governor focus on voucher program, economic development
